mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, sender_id, sender_role, type, content, client_msg_id, create_time, edited, edited_at, original_content, recalled, recalled_at FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, session_id, sender_id, sender_role, type, content, client_msg_id, create_time, edited, edited_at, original_content, recalled, recalled_at FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND ( create_time < #{cursorTime} OR (create_time = #{cursorTime} AND id < #{cursorId}) ) ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
